body:
New, real, general per-user settings home: user_settings table (real, typed columns, one row per user keyed by the JWT sub claim, matching this repo's own established 'one table per real feature' convention rather than a generic JSON blob), GET/PATCH /api/v1/settings/me, and a real /settings page -- both gated by RequireCookieAuth ALONE (no RequirePermission wrapper), a real, deliberate first for this codebase: every other cookie-protected page here is admin/devportal-gated, this one is for any authenticated user. First real setting: high_contrast, applied live on the settings page itself via a real body.high-contrast CSS override, proving the toggle round-trips end to end -- wiring it into every other IDUNA/WOTAN page is real, named, separate follow-up, not silently claimed done. 4 new tests (default-false, real PATCH+GET round trip, per-user isolation, unauthenticated rejection). go build/vet/test clean across the whole repo. Live-verified: migration applied cleanly under iduna.service (user_settings table confirmed present in the real live DB), both routes correctly return 401 unauthenticated. Commit 162bf60.

⚓ ☃
title: WOTAN-24412/ACCESSABILITY-14441: real per-user settings + high contrast shipped
